description: Source file implementing the ProcessGroupWrapper class for distributed communication in PyTorch, including collective operation checks, fingerprinting, and backend interactions.

classes.name: CollectiveFingerPrint
classes.description: A class representing a fingerprint of a collective operation, including operation type, tensor info, and sequence number, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and verification.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the collective fingerprint against a backend to ensure consistency across ranks.

methods.name: deserialize_fingerprint
methods.description: Deserializes a tensor into a CollectiveFingerPrint object.

methods.name: serialize_fingerprint
methods.description: Serializes the collective operation info into a tensor.

methods.name: compute_collective_diff
methods.description: Compares two collective fingerprints to identify differences.

methods.name: get_size_strs
methods.description: Returns string representations of tensor sizes.

methods.name: get_dtype_strs
methods.description: Returns string representations of tensor data types.

methods.name: get_device_type_strs
methods.description: Returns string representations of tensor device types.
